name: Strike example agent #1
description: Proposes weekly strikes for Strike's TSLA covered-call and cash-secured-put vaults on Robinhood Chain testnet. It never holds vault funds: the EpochManager checks every proposal against the vault's immutable mandate, and a rejected proposal slashes this agent's USDG bond to depositors. Strike posts each settled epoch's PnL and each rejection to the ERC-8004 Reputation Registry.
